message: No detected input validation: The code loads .npy files and casts to float32 but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, shape guards, or value-range validation on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read directly from a local filesystem path via np.load() with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authenticated remote fetch.

No detected label flipping detection: Labels are programmatically assigned as zeros (normal) and ones (abnormal) with no validation of label distributions, comparison against expected sets, or label-noise detection tools.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation pipeline applies only StandardScaler normalization and splitting; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering steps to defend against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: No hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision are performed when loading model weights or serialized models; models are constructed from scratch via tf_models functions with no integrity validation.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance or validates the label distribution before training; data is loaded and used directly without any distribution checks.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense mechanism in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) applied anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a test/validation split exists, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and only a single metric (AUC) is computed with no independent verification or isolation mechanism to prevent metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: Data is loaded directly from numpy files and passed to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: The compute_probs and compute_AUC functions perform no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on model outputs before using them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM; it is an audio anomaly detection autoencoder, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
